name: @drako/socialcors
description: App Next.js/OpenNext propia de SocialCors (P3). Etapa alias: usa node_modules y src/ de la raíz del monorepo.

scripts.build: ../../node_modules/.bin/next build && node -e 'const fs=require("fs"); const path=require("path"); const dirs=[".next/standalone/.next/server", ".next/server"]; dirs.forEach(d => fs.mkdirSync(d, {recursive: true})); ["BUILD_ID", "required-server-files.json"].forEach(f => { const src=path.join(".next", f); const dst=path.join(".next/standalone/.next", f); if(fs.existsSync(src)) fs.copyFileSync(src, dst); }); if(fs.existsSync(".next/server")) fs.cpSync(".next/server", ".next/standalone/.next/server", {recursive: true, force: true}); ["pages-manifest.json", "app-build-manifest.json"].forEach(m => { dirs.forEach(d => { const p=path.join(d, m); if(!fs.existsSync(p)) fs.writeFileSync(p, "{}"); }); });'
